premises.text: College recruiting is increasingly competitive and startups/mid-size firms struggle to compete with big campus spenders even though hiring great students hits the bottom line
premises.evidence_span: how can a startup or a medium-sized company compete effectively with the big guys on campus?

premises.text: Relationships win student hires, but traditional networking/referral recruiting fails because students are poorly connected and new to the workforce
premises.evidence_span: traditional recruiting services don't work well for college recruiting. And the reason is you can't rely on networking and referrals because students usually are not well connected

premises.text: Meritful is an SRM platform-as-a-service that helps companies build and manage multi-year relationships with students after campus touchpoints
premises.evidence_span: Meritful is a platform as a service for college recruiting teams to build and manage their relationship with students over multiple years

premises.text: Companies use ambassadors, challenges, and project feedback so students interact with employees while recruiters track development toward offers
premises.evidence_span: companies can create challenges for students to work on. This can be programming, design, business challenges, and students can submit solutions and interact with professionals at the company while at it

premises.text: Meritful is free for students and sold to companies on a monthly subscription
premises.evidence_span: Meriful is always free for students and is available at a monthly subscription to companies

value.text: Growing companies hire talented students by building sustained relationships rather than one-time campus visits
value.evidence_span: If you want to hire the best students, you need to build a relationship with them, and we have built just the platform for you

causal_links.evidence_span: just like in traditional recruiting, relationships are the key to hiring great students
This goes far beyond the one-time interaction that happens when a college recruiter visits a campus
Meriful is always free for students and is available at a monthly subscription to companies

notes: Competitive campus recruiting and LinkedIn-style referral failure folded as one problem set motivating SRM (§4.1.6). Ambassador invites, challenges, project showcase, and pipeline tracking folded as cascade of the relationship platform (§4.1.7). Private-beta logos treated as traction. Three domains are recruiting problem, SRM product, and pricing—anti-template: long-cycle relationship mechanics separately revisable from subscription packaging.
